title: 03.04 - Browsers supported by EUSurvey
intent: List the browsers supported by EUSurvey for participants.
short_answer: EUSurvey supports the last two versions of Microsoft Edge and the latest versions of Mozilla Firefox and Google Chrome.
procedure: Use a supported browser: Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, or Google Chrome.
If you experience compatibility issues, try again using one of the supported browsers.
important_conditions: Using other browsers may cause compatibility issues.
Browser support may depend on the browser version used.
